messages:
Evan Li: quick design QA — on small heights the modal close btn overlaps the success toast when you trigger actions. users miss the toast entirely. Priya Rao: saw that too in testing. the close icon uses compact-surface tokens so it's visually tight. maybe we need a minimum gap token between controls + toast anchor. Marco Diaz: dev note: toasts are currently absolutely positioned at top-right of the viewport and use z-index: 1000. modal header has z-index: 1100. when modal height < 320px the toast slides under the close btn. Zoe Park: accessibility: if the toast is visually hidden, we still must announce success via aria-live. but visually it's confusing UX. prefer moving to inline toast anchored to header so it's spatially connected. a11y-bot: a11y check: "Ensure aria-live region exists inside modal for inline toasts or announce globally with reference to the triggering control." Evan Li: options: (A) bump toast z-index and add offset when modal open, (B) render inline ephemeral chip inside modal header, (C) shift toast to bottom on short viewports. Thoughts? Priya Rao: prefer (B) inline header chip. it's closer to action and avoids z-index shenanigans. Also helps with keyboard users since focus stays stable. Marco Diaz: inline chip is fine but be careful with spacing tokens — current header is using spacing-token: compact-01 which gives 4px between icon and edge. For chip we need at least spacing-token: compact-02 (8px) to avoid overlap. Zoe Park: microcopy: what should chip read? testers liked 'Saved' for autosave but for explicit actions 'Set as default' gave mixed signals. For generic confirm use 'Done' or 'Saved successfully'? shorter is better for tiny headers. Evan Li: vote for 'Saved' for success and 'Copied' for copy actions. keep it one word to avoid wrapping. Also include check icon for non-color indicator. Marco Diaz: CSS sketch: ``` .modal-header { position: relative; padding: var(--spacing-compact-02); } .inline-chip { position: absolute; right: 56px; top: 12px; display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; } @media (max-height: 360px) { .toast-global { display: none; } .inline-chip { display: flex; } } ``` Make sure right offset accounts for close button width + spacing token. Priya Rao: a11y nit: keep focus on triggering button. do not move focus to chip. add aria-live="polite" region inside modal to announce "Saved". Example: ```
// on success: document.getElementById('modal-announcer').textContent = 'Saved.' ``` And still render visual chip for sighted users. Zoe Park: color/contrast: chip background should be >= 3:1 against text. also include an accessible name on the close button (aria-label="Close dialog"). current icon-only button uses title only which isn't reliable for SRs. a11y-bot: reminder: "Interactive icons must have accessible names (aria-label or visually-hidden text). Focus styles must meet contrast ratio." Evan Li: next steps: Priya will produce 2 header mockups (chip + larger header gap) and one variant where global toast shifts to bottom on short heights. Marco will prototype the inline announcer and CSS offsets. Zoe will validate copy + contrast. I'll collect and close this thread once PR + mocks linked. Priya Rao: posting frames in #design in ~30m. tagging @Marco for implementation review and @Zoe for a11y signoff. :rocket:
